no_adcom_quote.quote: This application was not referred to an FDA advisory committee because this drug is not the first in its class, the safety profile is similar to that of other drugs approved for this indication, the clinical trial designs are acceptable, the efficacy findings are clear, and the safety profile is acceptable in light of the serious nature of the disease being treated.

summary: No FDA advisory committee was convened for the ONGENTYS (opicapone) NDA 212489. The Summary Review and Medical Review both state the application was not referred to an advisory committee because opicapone is the third COMT inhibitor in its class (after tolcapone and entacapone), the trial designs and efficacy findings were clear, and the safety profile was acceptable. With no AdComm held, there were no committee-driven changes to the approval.
